zh-Hans:
本版整合最新食物与运动选择优化，并保留DUO适配。

1. 食物和运动选项仅显示图标和名称，隐藏热量、P/F/C、营养参考及MET副标题。
2. 食物默认常用100项，优先按本人使用频次筛选；搜索仍覆盖完整13,535条图谱记录。
3. 运动搜索框常显，支持中文及英文名称搜索，未匹配时有空结果提示。
4. 营养、单位换算和运动消耗计算保持完整，历史记录继续兼容。

请测试：食物/运动列表打开即能搜索、搜索和清空恢复、选择后的数量/时间及保存、升级后的历史记录与合计。DUO请检查展开横屏双栏、收起或竖屏单栏、旋转后的卡片及趋势图。

版本1.2.0，构建号0。图谱当前随App离线打包。
en-US:
This build includes the latest food and exercise selector improvements and retains DUO adaptation.

1. Food and exercise rows show only icons and names. Calorie, P/F/C, nutrition-reference and MET subtitles are hidden.
2. The default food list contains 100 common foods, prioritizing personal usage. Search still covers all 13,535 atlas records.
3. Exercise search is always visible and supports Chinese and English names, with an empty-results state.
4. Nutrition data, unit conversion, exercise energy calculations and existing records remain supported.

Please test immediate search visibility, searching/clearing, selection and saving, amounts/times, and historical records/totals after upgrading. On DUO, verify unfolded landscape columns, folded/portrait single-column layout and cards/charts after rotation.

Version 1.2.0, build 0. The food atlas is bundled offline.
